content.text:
I fixed this in `packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownLinks.ts`. The bug was in the code that turns Markdown links into page URLs (`replaceMarkdownLinks`), not in the image handling. Two things were wrong, and I changed both:

1. **The link pattern matched too much.** The regex at line 106 treated `./file.md` as a link to `file.md` even when the path carried on, as in `./file.md__static_image_assets__/image.png`. It then rewrote it to something like `/docs/file__static_image_assets__/image.png`, which is why the image lookup ended up in `/static`. Now the `.md`/`.mdx` must be the end of the path: it has to be followed by whitespace, `)`, `#`, `?`, a quote, or the end of the line.
2. **Replacements could land on the wrong link.** The code replaced the *first* place the matched text appeared in the line, not the place it actually matched. So a real link like `[a](./file.md)` later in the line could still rewrite the image path before it. It now replaces at the exact position of the match.

**Testing:** I ran a scratch test (since deleted) on a line with the issue's image link plus `[a](./file.md)`, `[b](./file.md#x)`, `[e](file.md "t")`, `[c]: ./file.md` and `[d](<./file.md>)`. The image path is left alone, all the real doc links become `/docs/file`, and none are reported as broken. The existing `markdownLinks` tests pass (10/10).

The `docusaurus-plugin-content-docs` test suite has 4 failing tests and 10 failing snapshots. Those failures are identical with my change stashed, so they come from something else. I didn't touch the existing change to `package.json`.
